title: Four Kettles Make a Bath
subject: four flatmates whose boiler dies the week before the landlord's man can come, running every kettle and pan in the house in relay to fill one bath and drawing lots for who gets in first
caption: Irish trad folk-punk, ballad-session style with punk energy. Hard-strummed acoustic guitar, driving tenor banjo, shrill tin whistle melody, stomping bodhran, plain bass guitar. Raw pub-room recording with foot stomps and a rowdy crowd backing. Male lead with gang vocals, clearly sung, shout-along chorus. 150 BPM, D major. Rowdy, comic, defiant. No synths, no autotune, no electronic drums, no pop gloss, no polished arena reverb.
lyrics:
[Intro - banjo, tin whistle, stomps]

[Verse 1]
The boiler gave a cough on Monday night
A little blue flame and then no light
The landlord's man is booked till Saturday
So we'll have to wash the oul' fashioned way

[Chorus]
Four kettles make a bath, me boys
Two pans and a soup pot too
One's on the stairs and one's on the boil
And the last one's kept for you

[Verse 2]
We drew our names from Ciaran's hat
And Sinead won, and that was that
She's in there singing with the door ajar
While we pour it in like a pint at the bar

[Chorus]
Four kettles make a bath, me boys
Two pans and a soup pot too
By the time it's my turn on the list
It's lukewarm and the colour of stew

[Bridge - bodhran, whistle]
On Saturday the van pulls up
He turns one screw and it's fixed on the spot

[Chorus]
Four kettles made a bath, me boys
And we'll keep them on the shelf
The next time the boiler goes
You can carry the pans yourself

[Outro - full band stomp]
